verdict.rationale: Sierra's Explorer and Insights products explicitly provide AI-generated insights: natural-language querying across conversations, automated weekly briefings on trends/issues without being asked, one-click drill-down investigation, and reasoning traces behind agent actions. This directly matches the story of surfacing AI-generated insights/suggestions from data inside the product, with first-party docs across multiple product pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Explorer's insight quality and no evidence of user-facing 'suggestions' beyond trend detection.
